name: context_compressor_is_blank_user_turn
notes: Traced copy of context_compressor_pure.c::cc_is_blank_user_turn vs LIVE ContextCompressor._is_blank_user_turn over 13 message shapes (null/string/array content, empty strings, text blocks, image/unknown blocks, summary metadata, non-user role). DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCE: C tests string emptiness with strlen==0 while LIVE uses .strip(), so whitespace-only text is blank in LIVE but non-blank in C — such inputs excluded. Content-based summary-content detection (_is_context_summary_content) is outside the traced surface.
